title: finding: 12 of the 15 object-metadata write call sites route through neither objectui#7714 guard — and a `client.save(` sweep cannot see them
body:
Filed from the objectui#8057 fix (dev seat, session `session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S`). ⛔ Unassigned; grading and `domain:*` are triage's.

objectui#8057's triage made a point that outlives its fix:

> objectui#7714's ruling names two writers and its PR guards both — and the surface that reproduced the failure **in that card's own required dogfood** is a third writer neither guard covers. ⇒ **is there a fourth?** A ruling that enumerates writers is only as good as the enumeration.

I swept for it. There is a fourth, and there are eight more after that. Separately — and this is the part I think matters most — **the sweep shape that question is naturally asked in cannot find them.**

## The measurement

Population proved live before any zero was read (lit control `doSave`, 10 files):

```
git grep -ln 'doSave' -- 'packages/*/src/*' 'apps/*/src/*'
```

Population: 3962 files under `packages/*/src/*`, 191 under `apps/*/src/*`.

```
{ git grep -n '\.save[<(]'      -- 'packages/*/src/*' 'apps/*/src/*';
  git grep -n 'meta\.saveItem(' -- 'packages/*/src/*' 'apps/*/src/*'; } \
  | grep -v '\.test\.' | grep -vE ':[0-9]+: *(\*|//|/\*)' | grep -vE '\* ' \
  | grep -E "'object'|\((type|parentType|current\.type)|save<" | sort -u

git grep -n 'toFieldsMap' -- 'packages/*/src/*' | grep -v '\.test\.'
```

Measured on `4eb665bcf`: **15 object-metadata write call sites across 10 files.**

`toFieldsMap` — the objectui#7714 guard — exists in exactly **two files** and guards **three** of those call sites:

- `packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.ts:716, :853` (`toFieldsMap` at `:186`, `:850`)
- `packages/plugin-designer/src/MetadataFieldsPage.tsx:539` (`toFieldsMap` at `:537`)

**Twelve call sites across eight files route through neither guard:**

| File | Lines | Type argument |
|---|---|---|
| `metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx` | 1475 | generic `type` — objectui#8057, now gated on server refusals |
| `metadata-admin/EmbeddedItemEditor.tsx` | 120 | generic `parentType` |
| `metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` | 755 | generic `type` |
| `metadata-admin/datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.tsx` | 427 | literal `object` |
| `views/runtime-metadata-persistence.ts` | 207, 314 | generic `type` |
| `studio-design/PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx` | 252 | literal `object` |
| `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` | 1886, 2988, 3010, 3053 | generic + three literal `object` |
| `plugin-designer/MetadataObjectsPage.tsx` | 257 | literal `object` |

## ⭐ The methodological half — why this stayed invisible

Two spellings reach the same PUT, and the obvious sweep sees neither reliably.

1. **`client.save(` misses the generic-call form.** `git grep -c '\.save('` against `ResourceEditPage.tsx` — the file objectui#8057 is entirely about — returns **0**. The call is `client.save<any>(type, savedName, itemToSave, …)`. `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx:755` is hidden the same way (`client.save<PermissionSetDraft>(`). Both need `\.save[<(]`.

2. **There is a second method entirely: `client.meta.saveItem(`.** That is how `MetadataService` writes — one of the two writers the ruling *did* name. A sweep spelled only as `client.save(` would report that named writer absent too.

⇒ Any future guard-coverage claim that greps `client.save(` will produce a confident zero over a population it never searched. That failure mode is what let a two-writer enumeration stand while a third writer reproduced the defect in the ruling's own dogfood.

## ⚠️ What is and is not measured

- **Measured**: these 12 call sites do not route through either `toFieldsMap`, on `4eb665bcf`, by the commands above.
- **NOT measured**: whether any of them actually emits a body the server refuses. Several write documents the designer never shapes into a `fields` map at all, so some are likely fine by construction.

This is filed as an **observation**, not as an asserted defect — deliberately no `pm:queue`. What it seems to warrant is a decision about whether guard coverage should be mechanical (a gate over the write call sites) rather than enumerated in prose, since the prose enumeration has now been falsified twice.

## Related

objectui#8057 (the third writer, fixed in PR #8675) · objectui#7714 (the two-writer ruling) · objectui#8058 / objectui#8060 (same family, `MetadataFieldsPage`) · `scripts/check-designer-field-key-parity.mjs` (key NAMES only — its own boundary section excludes value-level rejections)
